scope: NFL FIDOS local and validation foundations

threats.risk: A record from one organization is read or written through another organization scope.
An expired, forged, malformed, or under-permissioned token reaches a protected route.
A call sheet, wristband, or diagram is modified after generation and presented as canonical.
A lost tablet exposes queued play design or teaching data.
controls: AES-GCM IndexedDB queue and draft encryption
explicit compatibility warning when Web Crypto is unavailable

threats.risk: Bearer tokens, credentials, or secret material are written to logs or observability sinks.
Unbounded body size or repeated requests exhaust the local service.

limitations: Production WAF/KMS/identity-provider registration and live monitoring activation remain human-controlled.
